stories.i_want: the daily Meridian file picked up from SFTP and parsed using a configurable v3 layout
stories.so_that: card spend reaches Voyant every morning without manual entry

acceptance_criteria.given: a valid v3 file lands on the SFTP drop by 4 a.m. Eastern
acceptance_criteria.then: all records are parsed and loaded by 6 a.m. Eastern

acceptance_criteria.given: the layout configuration is updated
acceptance_criteria.then: the parser uses the new layout without a code release

acceptance_criteria.given: a record does not match the configured layout
acceptance_criteria.then: that record is rejected and logged, and the remaining records still load

stories.i_want: each file's record count checked against its trailer record
stories.so_that: we never load a partial or corrupted file

acceptance_criteria.given: a file whose record count matches the trailer
acceptance_criteria.then: the file is accepted for loading

acceptance_criteria.given: a file whose record count does not match the trailer
acceptance_criteria.then: the file is rejected, nothing is loaded, and an alert is raised

stories.i_want: a transaction resent in a later file to appear only once
stories.so_that: I don't have to delete duplicate expense lines

acceptance_criteria.given: a transaction with the same reference number, amount and date as one already loaded
acceptance_criteria.then: no second expense line is created

acceptance_criteria.given: a transaction with the same reference number but a different amount
acceptance_criteria.then: it is loaded and flagged for review

stories.i_want: card numbers masked to the last four digits before anything is written, and raw files deleted after processing
stories.so_that: Voyant never stores a full card number

acceptance_criteria.given: a file containing full card numbers
acceptance_criteria.then: only the last four digits are stored

acceptance_criteria.given: processing has finished
acceptance_criteria.when: the database, logs and file storage are searched for full card numbers
acceptance_criteria.then: none are found

stories.i_want: every system-generated expense line to record that it was system-generated, its source file and when
stories.so_that: auditors can trace any automatic action

acceptance_criteria.given: an expense line created from a card transaction
acceptance_criteria.then: it shows 'system-generated', the source file name and the creation time

stories.i_want: each card transaction matched to my SkyLane trip when its date falls within the trip dates plus or minus two days
stories.so_that: my card spend lands on the right trip automatically

acceptance_criteria.given: a hotel charge dated one day after checkout
acceptance_criteria.then: it is matched to that trip

acceptance_criteria.given: a transaction dated five days after the trip ends
acceptance_criteria.then: it is not matched and goes to the unassigned queue

stories.i_want: expense lines recorded at the amount the bank billed
stories.so_that: report totals match the card statement

acceptance_criteria.given: a transaction charged in GBP and billed in USD
acceptance_criteria.then: the expense line shows the billed USD amount

acceptance_criteria.given: a transaction with no billed amount
acceptance_criteria.then: it is flagged as a validation failure

stories.i_want: an expense line created automatically on my open report for each matched transaction
stories.so_that: I don't enter card expenses by hand

acceptance_criteria.given: a matched transaction and an open report for that trip
acceptance_criteria.then: an expense line is added to that report

acceptance_criteria.given: a matched transaction and no open report for that trip
acceptance_criteria.then: the transaction goes to the unassigned queue

stories.i_want: to see unmatched transactions in a queue, assign them myself, and get a reminder after three days
stories.so_that: nothing piles up until month end

acceptance_criteria.given: an unmatched transaction
acceptance_criteria.then: it appears in my unassigned queue and I can assign it to a report

acceptance_criteria.given: a transaction unassigned for three days
acceptance_criteria.then: I receive a reminder

acceptance_criteria.given: a transaction I assigned within three days
acceptance_criteria.then: no reminder is sent

stories.i_want: a view of today's file status, loaded count, validation failures and match rate
stories.so_that: we spot feed problems before travellers do

acceptance_criteria.given: today's file has been processed
acceptance_criteria.then: I see arrival time, loaded count, failures and match rate

acceptance_criteria.given: today's file has not arrived
acceptance_criteria.then: it shows 'not received'
